$comment: Likely-usage factor per node resource for the scarcity objective O2 (A85). O2 weighs a resource usage / map total NNE, so a resource that is rare on the map but little needed costs less than its rarity alone says. A resource not listed has usage 1. Values must be > 0, and each needs a reason. Keys are game_data.json part names that appear in data/nodes.csv. Every value is 1 for now, so plans are unchanged; each reason carries what `pnpm scarcity-sweep` suggested on 2026-10-13 (every part at 1/min under O1, all alternates, map pool: each resource's share of each plan's NNE summed over the 340 parts, divided by the mean, rounded to 0.01, floored at 0.05). Edit a value and say why in its reason.
